gameplan.summary: Roam after shoving waves and pick off isolated targets with charm. Scale into mobile assassin.
gameplan.win_condition: Charm into full combo for picks. Never fight fair — use Spirit Rush to outmaneuver.
gameplan.early_game: Q for waveclear and poke. E charm is your kill threat. Never use E defensively — save it for kills.
gameplan.positioning: Flank from side in teamfights. Spirit Rush in, charm, combo, Spirit Rush out.

leblanc.tips: She bursts faster than you. Buy early MR (Verdant Barrier). Dodge her Q mark with dash. Never let her chain CC.
leblanc.power_shift: Even at 2 items. Win through superior roaming — she's a solo lane bully, you're a roamer.

zed.tips: Charm him while he's in shadow form to stop combo. Buy Zhonya's — it counters his ult entirely.
zed.power_shift: He wins without Zhonya's; you win with it. Build Zhonya's second item.

yasuo.tips: His Windwall blocks your Q and orb. Bait Windwall then engage with E charm. Play around his no-shield HP.
yasuo.power_shift: He outduels at 2 items. Win through superior roaming and picking off squishy targets.

viktor.tips: Stay mobile to dodge his E gravity field — getting caught in it means full combo death. Roam frequently.
viktor.power_shift: He outscales in AoE teamfights. Win through picking off targets before 5v5s happen.

syndra.tips: She one-shots at level 9 with 7 orbs. Buy early MR. Dodge her E stun — it enables full combo.
syndra.power_shift: She outranges and outbursts you. Win by roaming constantly rather than fighting her.
